title: 8 Emergent.sh Alternatives: Better AI App Builders for 2026
summary: Looking for Emergent.sh alternatives? We tested 8 AI app builders and ranked them by full-stack capabilities, pricing, and production readiness. Real screenshots included.
body_markdown: Blink includes a database, authentication, and hosting in every plan — no external services required. Emergent generates the app code and provides deployment, but the database and auth layers are your responsibility. For non-technical founders, that's a significant practical difference. Blink's Pro tier is also $50/month versus Emergent's $200/month, with equivalent or better full-stack capabilities.
